examined_formations.title: CHINA_ZHEJIANG_RESTAURANT_PARTNERSHIP_COURT_RECONSTRUCTED_LEDGER_WITH_OWNER_WAGE_AND_REALIZED_SHUTDOWN_RESIDUAL
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A Zhejiang district-court judgment dated 2026-06-03 concerns one restaurant partnership formed on 2025-06-12, opened to customers on 2025-07-20 and closed in February 2026.
The partnership agreement placed final operating and decision authority with Lu; one 10% partner contributed RMB70,000.

For judicial settlement Lu supplied pre-opening schedules, July-December operating statements and supporting expense records; the court evaluated disputed items instead of accepting the operator ledger wholesale.

The court confirmed pre-opening renovation/equipment/rent/deposit spending of RMB548,372.41, monthly operating figures for July-September, adjusted October-December combined loss to RMB60,000 because of cross-store contamination, confirmed an RMB8,000 residual-asset acquisition by Lu and no refundable remainder of the RMB90,000 lease deposit.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The packet includes actual customer receipts rather than projected sales: August RMB209,968.35, September RMB140,697.05, October RMB154,061.78, November RMB109,050.42 and December RMB94,032.69.
It also exposes direct categories such as beef procurement, freight and wages and therefore provides substantially more auditable operating evidence than prior operator interviews.
The court accepted Lu's RMB5,000 monthly manager compensation for July-September but reduced its reasonableness later when his attention shifted to another restaurant.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Revenue weakened sharply while Lu simultaneously operated other restaurants, and the court found potential sharing of beef, drinks, grain/oil, parts and labor across stores.
The court explicitly adjusted late-period costs and owner compensation rather than treating contaminated bookkeeping as exact.
Remaining restaurant assets were competitively allocated to Lu for RMB8,000; the lease deposit was consumed by final rent/property/utilities/demolition liabilities and forfeiture.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is the first recent packet in the sequence that substantially closes entry cost, customer receipts, direct costs, owner-manager pay and realized shutdown residual for one operating unit.

The judgment's RMB706,335.70 cumulative-loss figure is a lifecycle settlement figure, not clean operating P&L: it mathematically incorporates the RMB548,372.41 pre-opening spend, court-recognized operating results and the RMB8,000 residual asset.

October-December bookkeeping was not position-pure because Lu also operated other restaurants; the court therefore used an equitable RMB60,000 combined-loss adjustment rather than validating every raw line item.
Operational evidence itself defeats founder independence: Lu received manager compensation, controlled final decisions, and revenue/cost quality deteriorated when his attention moved elsewhere.
economic_signal: Court-used August profit: RMB56,260.39 on RMB209,968.35 revenue and RMB153,707.96 costs.
Court-adjusted September loss: RMB132,118.43; October-December combined loss: RMB60,000.
Realized residual asset value: RMB8,000; lease-deposit residual: RMB0 after final liabilities/forfeiture.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Lu held final operating/decision authority, but the position is a conventional leased restaurant with substitutable suppliers, labor and local customer acquisition.
No exclusive transferable demand rail, proprietary data right or compounding noncommodity control surface is evidenced.
The same operator's attention was economically material, directly contradicting founder-light operation.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_HENAN_MICRO_REAL_ESTATE_COMPANY_EXECUTED_100_PERCENT_CONTROL_TRANSFER_WITH_AUDITED_ZERO_REVENUE
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Henan public-resource records classify Dengfeng Xingyue Real Estate Co., Ltd. as a micro enterprise with zero employees and 100% single-shareholder ownership.
The June 2026 transfer notice offered 100% of the company and explicitly stated the transaction would transfer actual control.
The August 2026 transaction result records a completed price of RMB333,400, equal to the listed and appraised price.
The acquirer also assumes company liabilities and capital-contribution obligations before asset delivery.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The company is an actual legal/control wrapper around real-estate-development and leasing rights and carries assets and liabilities despite zero employees.
2025 audited assets were RMB23.7585 million, liabilities RMB23.8241 million and net assets negative RMB65,600.
The April 2026 management accounts showed assets RMB23.7585 million, liabilities RMB23.8539 million and net assets negative RMB95,400.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The transfer structure prices the equity at only RMB333,400 while requiring the buyer to inherit roughly RMB23.8539 million of other payables and outstanding capital obligations.
A land-use issue disclosed in the transaction documents requires forestry approval before use of part of the underlying parcel.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The packet cleanly closes transfer price, 100% control, audited balance-sheet state and a completed transaction.
It fails the most basic value-flow test: 2025 audited operating revenue was RMB0 and the 2026-04-30 accounts also reported RMB0 revenue.
A cheap control price cannot be treated as attractive cashflow when the company has no received customer revenue and carries large liabilities.
Zero employees is not evidence of machine-delegatable profitable operation when there is no operating revenue to delegate.
economic_signal: 2025 audited revenue: RMB0; audited net loss: RMB65,600.
2026-04-30 revenue: RMB0; period net loss: RMB29,800.
2026-04-30 liabilities: RMB23.8539 million, explicitly assumed with other transfer obligations.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The buyer receives formal 100% corporate control, but public evidence does not establish a live customer/revenue rail.
The legal wrapper and underlying land/project rights are burdened by liabilities and approvals rather than demonstrated recurring external value flow.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_BEIJING_ZERO_EMPLOYEE_TECH_TRANSFER_CENTER_AUDITED_REVENUE_WITH_NONCONTROL_UNEXECUTED_6_PERCENT_EXIT_LISTING
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A September 2026 Beijing public-resource listing offers 6% of Beijing Zhongsheng Technology Achievement Transformation Center Co., Ltd. for RMB1.4555 million.
The company reports zero employees; the other shareholder owns 94%.
The public packet contains 2025 audited results and June 2026 management accounts.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: 2025 audited revenue was RMB427,000 with net loss RMB5.2066 million; assets RMB3.0694 million, liabilities RMB13.5789 million and net assets negative RMB10.5096 million.
For 2026 through June the company reported RMB63,200 revenue and RMB1.0782 million net loss, with net assets negative RMB11.5878 million.
The zero-employee structure demonstrates that low headcount can coexist with actual revenue, but not that the economics are attractive.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The 6% shareholder is attempting to exit through a formal property exchange at RMB1.4555 million.
The 94% shareholder has not waived pre-emption, reinforcing that the offered position is a constrained minority interest rather than operating control.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Audited revenue and loss bind to the exact entity and the offered equity interest has a public price.
The transaction is only a live listing as of the evidence date; no completed buyer/control transfer is published.
A 6% interest does not carry demonstrated operating control, and the 94% shareholder retains the dominant position.
Both audited and current-period economics are deeply loss-making despite low headcount.
economic_signal: 2025 audited revenue: RMB427,000; net loss: RMB5.2066 million.
2026 through June revenue: RMB63,200; net loss: RMB1.0782 million.
Zero employees; 2026-06-30 net assets negative RMB11.5878 million.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The offered stake is explicitly only 6%; the 94% shareholder remains dominant and retains pre-emption rights.
No public packet establishes exclusive customer-data, channel or action rights attached specifically to the minority stake.
